profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Liberty Mutual Insurance

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Migrated of over 1200 business rules to a go-forward business rules management system for Liberty Mutual’s Commercial Lines quoting application
- Planned, tested, and implemented high-priority features for a quoting application in Angular 2/TypeScript providing direct business value to users through enhanced functionality and increasing efficiency among users by 50%
- Participated and contributed to various Agile Scrum ceremonies including Daily Scrum, Sprint Planning, and Retrospectives
- Improved testing coverage by 25% of an application via unit and integration testing as well as practiced test-driven development using Jasmine, karma, and JUnit 
- Developed a social media web app in Angular 4 and Java for newly hired IT employees, utilizing Spring’s RESTful web services to update SQL database, and AWS for deployment
- Introduced a process improvement within the team to increase team communication and collaboration
- Helped create a microservice to transform old XML to newer versions so that they can be consumed properly and accurately by a GUI and implemented industry standard security configurations using OAuth 2.0 and OIDC to secure our service

positions.title: IT Analyst I, Technical Development Program
positions.description:
- Collaborated with other business analysts and developers to gather business requirements for auto-renewals for commercial line policies
- Redesigned my team’s new-hire page to onboard new hires and ensured that all of the necessary resources and environment-set up guides are readily available, reducing onboarding time by 40%
- Volunteered and participated in multiple agile ceremonies including leading stand-ups and retrospectives

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Prepared and lead lab sections that supplements lecture material
- Provided support to students by clarifying any concerns, answering any questions, and provide constructive feedback
- Responded to any emails from students, colleagues, and from the professor in a timely manner
- Graded student assignments and provided constructive feedback

positions.title: Human Resources Assistant
positions.description:
- Review applications, checking availability and qualifications
- Place students into positions, matching unit schedules and manager preferences with student availability and eligibility
- Review professional and classified candidates' references
- Create/analyze weekly reports such as recording open labor hours for each unit to determine recruitment needs
- Process documentation
- Schedule interviews between potential candidates and unit managers
- Created and maintained workflows with SharePoint and SharePoint Designer
- Troubleshoot any workflow issues

positions.title: IT Business Analyst Intern
positions.description:
- Communicated with stakeholders and business partners to identity project requirements and risks
- Created daily and weekly project reports which were distributed to managers and project teams
- Developed user stories that identified project and business needs for developers, QA testers, and other business partners
- Helped tracked projects and reported status changes to project managers and other analysts
- Facilitated in capturing change requests for stakeholders and reported any resource impacts
- Translated technical requirements for various projects to business and marketing partners

positions.title: HR Information Systems Operations Intern
positions.description:
- Gain experience on human resources information systems
- Troubleshoot various HR needs including passwords, security maintenance, and task entry 
- Assess data needs when requested to ensure valid output
- Analyze/interpret data audits for solutions
- Assist with data updates in a variety of applications (SharePoint, Content Management System, Issue Tracking System, PeopleSoft, etc.)

positions.title: Human Resources Assistant
positions.description:
- Respond to ad-hoc project from co-workers
- Develop my interpersonal communications skills
- Support my coworkers through various projects such as data analysis, checking for candidates' credentials and licensing, and checked their basic eligibility
- Help new employees with their paperwork
- Resolve customer requests, questions, and/or issues
- Handle confidential information

projects.title: INFO 360: UW Event Tracker
projects.description:
• Collaborated to create iOS app for UW students to track and promote campus events
• Conducted interviews and administered surveys to over 50 undergrads to understand target
population’s needs and desires
• Created a conceptual model to break down each individual process of the Event Tracker
•  Helped design the logo using illustrator
